name: How long does it take to install non-slip kitchen flooring?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install non-slip kitchen flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation timeframe for non-slip kitchen flooring typically ranges from one to several days, depending on the material and kitchen size. Simple vinyl or linoleum installations in smaller kitchens can often be completed quicker. More complex projects involving tile, extensive subfloor preparation, or custom layouts will require more time. Our team works efficiently to minimize disruption, and we will provide a clear timeline during the project planning phase.
